Name: ESTUS_FLASK_RECOVERY_PARAM_ST
Description: Flask charges restored when an enemy is killed. The enemy's NpcParam Flask Recovery Param ID picks the row; the same ID is looked up in HPEstusFlaskRecoveryParam (Crimson Flask charges) and MPEstusFlaskRecoveryParam (Cerulean Flask charges). The column is picked by the local player's multiplayer role and how they joined. Charges are only given when the enemy's flask recovery chance (NpcParam) succeeds and the player holds fewer charges than their flask allotment. Shared by both params.

Fields.Name: Host
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored to the host, or to any player who is neither a cooperator nor an invader (including offline play). Retail: 1 to 15.

Fields.Name: Invasion Orb - None
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored to an invader who joined by invading (not by a summon sign).

Fields.Name: Invasion Orb - Gold
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (only the first invasion column is read).

Fields.Name: Invasion Orb - Berserker
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (only the first invasion column is read).

Fields.Name: Invasion Orb - Sinner
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (only the first invasion column is read).

Fields.Name: Invasion Sign - None
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored to an invader summoned by a red summon sign (duelist).

Fields.Name: Invasion Sign - Gold
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (only the first sign-invader column is read).

Fields.Name: Invasion Sign - Berserker
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (only the first sign-invader column is read).

Fields.Name: Invasion Sign - Sinner
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (only the first sign-invader column is read).

Fields.Name: Invasion Ring
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored to an invader who joined through a ring-type summon (hunter or guardian join types). Only used while an extra session condition is met; otherwise the invader gets 0.

Fields.Name: Invasion Ring - Rosalia
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (only the first ring-invader column is read).

Fields.Name: Invasion Ring - Forest
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (only the first ring-invader column is read).

Fields.Name: Coop Sign - None
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored to a cooperator summoned by a summon sign (for example with a Furled Finger). Retail: 0 to 8.

Fields.Name: Coop Sign - Gold
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (only the first cooperator sign column is read).

Fields.Name: Coop Sign - Berserker
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (only the first cooperator sign column is read).

Fields.Name: Coop Sign - Sinner
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (only the first cooperator sign column is read).

Fields.Name: Coop Ring - Hunter
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored to a cooperator who joined through a ring (a hunter, as with the Blue Cipher Ring). Only used while an extra session condition is met; otherwise the cooperator gets 0.

Fields.Name: Invasion Ring - Anor
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game (only the first ring-invader column is read).

Fields.Name: Replacement Rate
Fields.Description: Chance out of 10000 to use the Replacement ID row instead of this one, rolled on each kill (replaced when a 0–10000 roll is at or below this value, so 0 still has a 1 in 10001 chance). Only checked when Replace ID is 0 or more. Retail: 300 (HP) and 150 (FP) on the 10100–10600 and 20100–20600 chains.

Fields.Name: Replace ID
Fields.Description: Row of the same param used instead when the Replacement Rate roll succeeds. Only one replacement is made: the replacement row's own Replace ID is not followed. A missing row keeps this row. -1: none.
